svg.aria-label: Every room on the Capvise Global calendar, drawn as a route across a world map. 2025, four rooms: Bali, Singapore, Dubai, Buenos Aires. 2026, thirteen rooms: Hong Kong twice, Cannes twice, Paris, Bali, Barcelona, Seoul, Singapore twice, Mumbai twice and London. 2027, sixteen on the calendar: Hong Kong, Cannes, Bangkok, Miami, Amsterdam, New York, Nashville, Bali, Hong Kong, San Francisco, Singapore, Las Vegas, Singapore, Bangkok, Dubai and Abu Dhabi.
svg.title: Every room on the Capvise Global calendar, drawn as a route across a world map. 2025, four rooms: Bali, Singapore, Dubai, Buenos Aires. 2026, thirteen rooms: Hong Kong twice, Cannes twice, Paris, Bali, Barcelona, Seoul, Singapore twice, Mumbai twice and London. 2027, sixteen on the calendar: Hong Kong, Cannes, Bangkok, Miami, Amsterdam, New York, Nashville, Bali, Hong Kong, San Francisco, Singapore, Las Vegas, Singapore, Bangkok, Dubai and Abu Dhabi.
